subject: Re: Friday delivery window
text:
Hi,

I'm really glad we got that first delivery slot sorted, because I'd started pacing around the dorm room. I just have a small time-sensitive change, though, and I'm sorry to be annoying. The lab switched my shift to 3:15 because someone called out, so the old drop-off time no longer works. Could the courier maybe arrive before 1:30 instead? I can meet them at the side entrance if that's easier, or I'll have the package signed for by the front desk if you've already arranged that at work.

The books and the small printer cartridge are still in the same box, so nothing needs to be repacked. The label on the lid is still correct, so no new paperwork should be necessary. Please tell them not to leave it outside, since it might rain around 4. If the earlier time is impossible, I can take the subway there in the morning and collect it myself, but I'd rather not lose two hours if the schedule is tight.

Also, if anyone at the warehouse needs to call the person named on the delivery slip, use the number I sent last week rather than the campus office line, because that office closes early on Fridays. If you need me to approve a rebooking on my end, just send a quick message; I'll refresh my inbox before I leave.

Thanks so much for helping me sort this out. I owe you a coffee, or possibly the entire pastry case.

Cheers,
